# Pipeline Test

## Overview

The Pipeline Test artifact documents the behavior and configuration of the [wiki compiler](./wiki-compiler.md) operating in [heuristic mode](./heuristic-mode.md). Designed as part of an LLM Wiki pipeline test, its primary goal is to process over 40 raw files into a rich, interconnected knowledge graph while surfacing contradictions (such as those regarding battery, herbal presets, and read intervals).

## Key Details

- **Core Functionality:** Heuristic mode reads all `.txt` and `.md` files located under `data/raw/` to extract topics without requiring an LLM API key.
- **Output Generation:** Automatically generates Docusaurus-compatible pages under `wiki-app/docs/`.
- **Cross-Linking:** Automatically builds cross-links based on entity mentions throughout the processed text.
- **Test Data Layout:** 
  - `data/raw/samples/` contains files prefixed with `[SAMPLE]`.
  - `data/raw/dummy-test/` contains files labeled with `[DUMMY TEST DATA]`.
  - Includes original junk data generated by `generate_junk_data.py`.
- **Known Ingest Quirks:**
  - Broken markdown exports test parser resilience.
  - Forum HTML scrapes can lose nested content.
  - Email threads may include wrong-thread noise.
